[SWS_CM_01104] Query Subscription State on Skeleton side
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00106
⌈
GetSubscriptionState on the skeleton side defined in [SWS_CM_01109] shall return
kSubscribed if at least one active subscription to this triggertrigger exists and kNotSub-
scribed otherwise. kSubscriptionPending shall not be used on the Server side.
⌋
7.5.16 Send trigger
For the trigger sending C++ API reference, see [SWS_CM_00721]. The Communica-
tion Management shall send trigger to all subscribing applications.
